title: Forecast Review Cadence Freshness
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:ops horizon_bucket=* last_review_epoch=* snapshot_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((snapshot_epoch-last_review_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by horizon_bucket
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures review freshness by horizon bucket for forecast review cycles.
value: Lag tracking shows which horizon bucket create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside forecast review cycles.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `review freshness` on `forecast:ops` events and aggregate them by `horizon_bucket`.
visualization: Table of horizon bucket with average and worst review freshness.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how long things take for each horizon bucket so you can see where forecast review cycles slows down.
